summary_en: TOYO Corporation completed cancellation of 4,000,000 treasury shares on September 18, 2026, representing 15.3% of issued shares before cancellation. Outstanding shares after cancellation total 22,085,000.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Treasury Stock Cancellation
translation_en_brief: TOYO Corporation completed the cancellation of 4,000,000 treasury shares of common stock on September 18, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Company Law. The cancellation was decided at the Board of Directors meeting held on August 5, 2026. This cancellation reduces the number of issued shares from 26,085,000 to 22,085,000 shares. The cancelled shares represent 15.3% of the issued share count prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company holds 1,199,490 treasury shares remaining on its balance sheet.
